title: DEPARTMENT REPORT dated August 28, 2026, relative to the Quadruped Unmanned Ground
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT REPORT dated August 28, 2026, relative to the Quadruped Unmanned Ground
  Vehicle Annual Inspection Report for 2025 - 2026, as set forth.  [BPC #26-303]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s Report and TRANSMIT to City Council.
summary: Board approval of LAPD’s 2025-2026 annual inspection report for quadruped unmanned ground vehicles.
